title: Moroccan/Arabian
content: Apply Moroccan/Arabian aesthetic with exotic ornamental beauty. Intricate geometric patterns: stars, arabesques, tessellations. Rich jewel tone colors: sapphire, ruby, emerald, gold. Ornate borders and frames. Include mosaic tile patterns. Pointed arch (Moorish arch) shapes. Lantern and light motifs. Luxurious textiles: silk, velvet textures. Mysterious, romantic, opulent atmosphere.

variants.simple: Create ornate Moroccan aesthetic with geometric patterns, jewel tones, and exotic elegance.
variants.detailed: Apply Moroccan/Arabian aesthetic with exotic ornamental beauty. Intricate geometric patterns: stars, arabesques, tessellations. Rich jewel tone colors: sapphire, ruby, emerald, gold. Ornate borders and frames. Include mosaic tile patterns. Pointed arch (Moorish arch) shapes. Lantern and light motifs. Luxurious textiles: silk, velvet textures. Mysterious, romantic, opulent atmosphere.
variants.advanced: Apply Moroccan/Arabian aesthetic with ornamental Islamic art influence. Geometric patterns: complex tessellations, 8-point stars, arabesque curves, interlocking shapes - implement as SVG patterns or CSS backgrounds. Follow Islamic geometry principles (no figural representation). Color palette: rich jewel tones - sapphire blue (#0f4c81), ruby red (#9b111e), emerald green (#046307), amethyst purple (#9966cc), with gold (#d4af37) outlines and accents. Tiles: zellige mosaic patterns, square or hexagonal arrangements, grout lines visible. Architectural elements: Moorish pointed arches (keyhole shape), carved screens (mashrabiya), domed shapes. Typography: decorative fonts suggesting Arabic calligraphy, or pair elegant serif with geometric display fonts. Lanterns: Moroccan lamp shapes, cut-out patterns casting decorative shadows, warm amber glow. Textiles: rich damask patterns, velvet texture, silk sheen, tassels and fringe details. Metal work: hammered brass textures, filigree patterns, ornate handles. Doors: famous Moroccan door motifs, studded, colorful, arched. Interactive: pattern reveals, lantern glow intensifies on hover. Borders: complex geometric bands, corner ornaments. Photography: saturated colors, souks and riads, spices and textiles. Implementation: SVG essential for complex patterns, CSS custom properties for color variations. Accessibility: busy patterns need careful text placement, ensure contrast.
